verdict.rationale: cubic documents an Analytics API (cubic-docs-20), an MCP server and a CLI, so an API versioning and deprecation axis applies to it. Nothing in the evidence mentions API version numbers, version pinning, or a deprecation or sunset policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Having an API at all is adjacent and earns no credit for versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
